meta.name: pdf-processing-pro
meta.description: Production-ready PDF processing with forms, tables, OCR, validation, and batch operations. Use when working with complex PDF workflows in production environments, processing large volumes of PDFs, or requiring robust error handling and validation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量处理PDF表单、表格、OCR和验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要自动化处理大量PDF文档
copy.tagline_en: Process PDF forms, tables, OCR, and validation in batch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to automate processing of large volumes of PDFs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可通过脚本完成 PDF 的文本/表格提取、表单分析与填写、合并/拆分、完整性校验、OCR 识别和批量处理。脚本均带错误处理、日志和退出码。
howto.when: 当你在生产环境处理复杂 PDF 工作流、批量处理大量 PDF，或需要稳健的错误处理和验证时触发。

say.text: 把这份 PDF 里的表格提出来，存成 CSV。
say.note: 会运行表格提取脚本，生成 CSV 文件。

say.text: 帮我把这份 PDF 表单填上数据。
say.note: 会先校验数据，再生成填写后的新 PDF。

say.text: 把这三个 PDF 合并成一个。
say.note: 会调用合并脚本，输出合并后的 PDF。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process PDFs using pre-built scripts: extract text and tables, analyze and fill forms, merge/split PDFs, validate integrity, perform OCR, and batch process. Scripts include error handling, logging, and exit codes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when working on complex PDF workflows in production, processing large volumes of PDFs, or requiring robust error handling and validation.

say_en.text: Extract the tables from this PDF into a CSV.
say_en.note: Runs the table extraction script and creates a CSV.

say_en.text: Fill in this PDF form with the provided data.
say_en.note: Validates data first, then outputs a filled PDF.

say_en.text: Merge these three PDFs into one.
say_en.note: Uses the merge script to output a combined PDF.
